critical_code_review_comments: KioskChat.jsx renders a MessageCircle icon with only text-slate-700 + a white drop-shadow; against the orange gradient of the kiosk header the icon is still visible but marginal — consider a subtle backdrop pill (like the KtpPairPill) for consistency with the rest of the kiosk header affordances.

kiosk-chat.js installKioskChat() only guards against double-install via a module-level `installed` flag; because `role` is reassigned on every call, if the same tab is reused and role changes (admin→employee or vice versa — e.g. after /auth/logout followed by a kiosk-pin re-login without full reload) the global 'kiosk-chat' listener keeps the previous role. Low likelihood on real kiosks (which hard-reload on login) but worth documenting.

sendChat creates optimistic messages but never promotes them to 'sent' on timeout/error — if the WS is down the bubble remains with a single-check (pending) forever and no retry is attempted. Consider surfacing a failure state after e.g. 10s with a retry affordance.

_chat_send performs db.kiosk_chat.delete_many({created_at:{$lt:_today_start_iso()}}) on every message — fine at low volume but at scale this is one unindexed scan per send. An index on (company_id, created_at) + moving the TTL cleanup to a nightly job / Mongo TTL index on created_at would be cleaner.

_chat_threads aggregation does not filter by cutoff per thread — it uses $last on messages after $match + $sort by created_at ascending. That is correct but relies on $last respecting document order post-$sort which is guaranteed only inside a single $group stage; code is fine, worth a comment.

KioskChat panel uses z-[10001] (above kiosk-prints-overlay at z-[10000]), which is good — but the kiosk-chat-btn itself is z-40, below the prints overlay. In practice the prints overlay auto-opens when a new employee logs in, which can hide the chat icon on the admin side until the admin dismisses it. Not a regression (existing z-ordering), but worth considering raising kiosk-chat-btn to z-[60] so admins can always reach chat during an active prints session.
